entity.summary: Hardware-wallet ecosystem whose Prokey Optimum device keeps private keys offline and uses a web-based companion wallet interface.
entity.notes: Prokey's first-party launch post dated 2020-07-02 explicitly announces the launch of the first product in its hardware-wallet lineup, Prokey Optimum. The current product page continues to offer the device for sale.

products.summary: Prokey Optimum hardware wallet with offline device-held private keys and a web-based wallet interface.
products.notes: First-party launch article explicitly launches Prokey Optimum on 2020-07-02; the current product page offers it for purchase. Support status remains conservative `unknown`.

events.title: Prokey Optimum firmware v1.10.5 released
events.description: The official Prokey Optimum firmware repository published firmware v1.10.5 on 2023-10-09 with support for OKChain Token, providing dated first-party lifecycle evidence for the Prokey Optimum hardware wallet.

evidence.title: Official Launching Of The Prokey Optimum
evidence.notes: First-party Prokey launch article explicitly announces the launch of Prokey Optimum, the first product in the hardware-wallet lineup, on 2020-07-02.

evidence.title: Prokey Optimum
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page offers Prokey Optimum for sale and states private keys remain offline on the hardware device.

evidence.title: Prokey Firmware v1.10.5
evidence.notes: Official Prokey Optimum firmware GitHub release.
